definition: Great force or intensity in expressing a feeling or making a sound.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: The cry had been loud on account of its vehemence, but it had pealed out from somewhere far off on the shadowy plain.
example_sentence: She denied eating the last biscuit with suspicious vehemence.
